steps: Locate the exact squeaky board by walking slowly.
Drill a small pilot hole through the board into the joist below.
Drive a specialty breakaway screw (e.g., Counter-Snap) until the head snaps off below the surface.
Fill the tiny hole with a matching color wax filler stick.
Buff with a soft cloth to blend the repair.
videoTitle: How To Fix Squeaky Floors - This Old House
